use_when: 分享
跨应用分享
跨设备分享
文字分享
图片分享

如何让应用作为目标应用接收其他应用分享的内容？
如何实现分享内容直达应用的特定界面？
如何通过App Linking实现分享直达应用？
如何获取分享操作的结果回调？
如何自定义配置分享面板的操作区？
如何共享联系人信息到分享推荐区实现一步分享到指定用户？
如何实现碰一碰跨端分享和可信任设备间传输？
如何实现手机与PC/2in1设备间的相互分享？
如何排查拉起系统分享框失败或分享数据类型不支持的问题？
当你需要在应用中添加"分享"功能，让用户将文本、图片、视频、链接等内容分享到其他应用时，应使用Share Kit
它提供了完整的分享面板，自动匹配能处理分享内容的目标应用，并支持自定义配置操作区
当你需要实现跨设备分享时，Share Kit支持碰一碰分享和隔空传送两种模式，可在可信任设备间安全传输分享内容
目标设备可接收分享数据并实现一步直达体验
当你需要让应用作为分享接收方出现在系统分享面板中时，需要在应用中构建数据处理能力并在配置文件中声明支持的UTD类型
调用系统分享面板发送文本、图片、视频或网页链接 / Invoke the system share panel to send text, images, videos, or web links
接入系统分享能力把应用里的文件分享到微信、邮件或其他应用 / Integrate system sharing to send in-app files to WeChat, email, or other apps
实现应用接收其他应用分享进来的图片、文档或链接 / Implement receiving images, documents, or links shared from other apps
处理分享到应用后的拉起参数并跳转到指定页面 / Handle share launch parameters and route to a specific page
分享海报、截图或导出的文件给其他应用 / Share posters, screenshots, or exported files to other apps
从应用内直接把商品详情页或文章链接分享出去 / Share a product detail page or article link directly from the app
获取分享成功、取消或失败的结果回调 / Get callbacks for share success, cancel, or failure
配置分享面板的推荐目标和操作入口 / Configure recommended targets and action entries in the share panel
实现一键把联系人名片或内容分享到指定联系人 / Implement one-tap sharing of a contact card or content to a specified contact
接入 App Linking 让分享链接打开应用内对应内容页 / Integrate App Linking so shared links open the corresponding in-app content page
实现手机与平板、PC之间的跨设备内容分享 / Implement cross-device content sharing between phone, tablet, and PC
通过碰一碰或可信设备发现发起近场分享 / Start nearby sharing through touch-to-share or trusted device discovery
do_not_use_when: 需求是生成或解析应用深链、通用链接以实现页面唤起，而不是调起系统分享面板 / The need is to create or resolve app deep links or universal links for page routing rather than invoke the system share panel; use app-linking-kit
需求是分发应用、应用详情曝光、应用下载或商店内推荐，而不是分享用户内容 / The goal is app distribution, app detail exposure, app download, or in-store recommendation rather than sharing user content; use appgallery-kit
需求是投放、展示、点击或归因广告，而不是把文本图片视频链接分享给其他应用或设备 / The task is to serve, display, click, or attribute ads rather than share text, images, videos, or links to other apps or devices; use ads-kit
需求是扫码识别二维码或条码并解析结果，而不是把已有内容分享出去 / The task is to scan and decode QR codes or barcodes rather than send existing content out; use scan-kit

需求是游戏登录、成就、排行榜、圈子或组队等游戏服务能力，而不是通用内容分享 / The requirement is for game services such as game login, achievements, leaderboards, communities, or teaming rather than general content sharing; use game-service-kit

需求是基于系统场景感知做自动化推荐或场景联动，而不是显式由用户发起分享 / The requirement is context awareness, proactive recommendation, or scenario automation rather than an explicit user-initiated share action; use scenario-fusion-kit
preconditions: 设备与应用运行环境支持Share Kit相关能力，API版本满足所用接口要求 / The device and app runtime support Share Kit capabilities, and the API version meets the requirements of the used interfaces
分享数据已按UDMF的UTD规范组织，且单次分享总量不超过200KB、条目数不超过500 / Share data is organized according to UTD in UDMF, and each share stays within 200KB total and no more than 500 items
若应用作为接收方，需要在module.json5等配置中声明可处理的分享能力与UTD类型 / If the app acts as a receiver, it must declare share handling capability and supported UTD types in module.json5 or equivalent configuration
若使用跨设备分享，相关设备处于可用可信状态且系统侧跨端传输开关已开启 / If cross-device sharing is used, the relevant devices are available and trusted, and the system-side cross-device transfer switch is enabled
inputs: 分享内容数据项列表（文本、图片、视频、链接等） / Share content item list (text, images, videos, links, etc.)
内容类型描述与UTD标识 / Content type descriptors and UTD identifiers
分享面板或预览界面的配置参数 / Configuration parameters for the share panel or preview UI
分享结果回调或接收处理入口参数 / Share result callback or receiver handling entry parameters

postconditions.statement: 代码已构造符合Share Kit要求的分享数据，并包含对应内容类型或UTD信息 / The code constructs share data compatible with Share Kit and includes the corresponding content type or UTD information
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show creation or population of Share Kit share payload/data objects with explicit text/image/video/link typing or UTD-related metadata?

postconditions.statement: 代码已接入发起分享或接收分享的Share Kit调用链路 / The code integrates a Share Kit call path for either initiating a share or receiving shared content
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify code to invoke Share Kit APIs for launching a share flow, or to register/handle incoming shared content as a receiving app?

postconditions.statement: 若实现结果处理，代码已增加分享结果回调或接收后的处理逻辑 / If result handling is implemented, the code adds share-result callbacks or post-receipt processing logic
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set include callback handling, event handling, or page-routing logic that processes the outcome of sharing or the content received from a share?

postconditions.statement: 若应用作为目标应用，工程配置已声明可处理的分享类型或相关能力 / If the app acts as a target app, project configuration declares supported share types or related capabilities
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the implementation is for a receiving/target app, do the edits include configuration changes such as module.json5 or equivalent declarations for supported share data types, intents, or capabilities?
